rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Keychron V6 Ultra HE Kickstarter holds front-page momentum in its second week; Gamakay's teased Q2 TMR board broadens the magnetic-switch story.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: Still the default per MKB Guide's 2026 Cherry guide; Cherry's own TMR push (XTRFY MK Crystal) draws more spec-sheet attention than MX2A itself.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Lineup unchanged since the early-2026 four-switch expansion; steady stock at Gateron, KBDfans, Divinikey with no new SKUs this week.

rows.name: Gateron Lanes
rows.note: ThereminGoat review buzz fades into its third week; Geekhack tactile threads shift toward newer Magnetic Jade and TMR coverage instead.

rows.name: HMX Cloud V2
rows.note: Budget hot-swap linear remains widely stocked at UniKeys, Milktooth, SwitchOddities; no revision or restock news this week.

rows.name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
rows.note: Geekhack GB enters its final full week before the Aug 12 close; Prototypist and NovelKeys kittings push toward higher MOQ tier unlocks.

rows.name: GMK CYL TA Neo
rows.note: Production tracking toward Nov 2026 ship per Oblotzky/zFrontier; community chatter cools further as attention shifts to the OG Extensions close.

rows.name: Divinikey DCS Dolch
rows.note: Kitting-refund and MOQ-tier discussion continues on Divinikey's GB page; Oct 2026 ship estimate unchanged, interest plateauing a month post-close.

rows.name: GMK Beachy
rows.note: New GB listed on Keebz N Cables running Aug 18-Sept 22; Geekhack interest-check thread building ahead of launch.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Engadget's ergo roundup and Botmonster's programmer buyer's-guide (Glove80, ZSA Voyager, Kinesis Advantage360 Pro) keep split layouts as 2026's dominant search trend.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: MKB Guide's 'ergonomic compromise' framing persists as buyers keep choosing full split boards like the Q13 Max over Alice; no new Alice releases this week.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: PC Gamer's coverage of Mode's Encore 2026 refresh (new mounting system, 5 colorways) keeps 75% boards in the spotlight alongside KBD75 v3.

rows.name: Work Louder x OpenAI Codex Micro
rows.note: Resale prices holding near $700-800+ on eBay per Resell Calendar/eWeek; no confirmed restock date from Work Louder.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: PC Gamer covers Encore 2026's new mounting system; Sonnet 2026 and Monterey/Cacao caps continue fulfillment per Mode's own Summer 2026 update.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Paper 65 GB kit reverts to Q4 2026 per Prototypist's official listing, correcting last week's unconfirmed Aug/Sept read; steady incremental Geekhack interest.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Blaine V2: SE enters its final week before an Aug 9 close after a four-week run; the triple-mount F12 TKL kit was CannonKeys' first new GB since the Nyawice quiet window and holds steady closing-week interest.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: V6 Ultra HE Kickstarter holds dominant keyboard-news momentum in its second week post-launch; Notebookcheck and vgtimes continue hybrid Nova Socket coverage.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: XTRFY's MK Crystal TMR switches keep drawing spec comparisons even as the core MX2A lineup stays stagnant.

rows.name: Wuque Studio
rows.note: No GB or product news on Wuque's official blog this week; Mammoth V2 and Promise V2 remain unannounced follow-ups to NAMA's March 2026 ship.
